_comments.purpose: Drop-in snippet for ~/.chimera/mcp.json (read by chimera/cli/code.py at startup). Registers the chimera-team MCP server so a `chimera code -p` session can claim/complete tasks alongside Codex/OpenCode teammates.
_comments.merge_strategy: If ~/.chimera/mcp.json already exists, copy the mcpServers.chimera-team entry into the existing servers/mcpServers map. chimera/cli/code.py accepts either `servers` or `mcpServers` as the top-level key.
_comments.experimental_flag: CHIMERA_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is required — the team server refuses to start without it.
_comments.identity_env: CHIMERA_TEAM and CHIMERA_AGENT pick this Chimera process's teammate identity. Override them per session by exporting CHIMERA_TEAM=... CHIMERA_AGENT=... before launching `chimera code`.
_comments.teams_home: {{TEAMS_HOME}} should be an absolute path. Use the same value across all teammates so they share state — e.g. /Users/you/.chimera/teams or a workspace-local directory like /Users/you/projects/foo/.chimera-teams.
